description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Publishing the names of persons or categories to whom a certificate of Exceptions  were issued
categorisation: This gazette contains a legal notice from the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka issuing certificates of exemption under Section 10(3) of the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (Amended). It involves regulatory matters and statutory instruments related to electricity distribution licensing exemptions, which falls under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure categories.
